2026_01_WAS_PHI.headline: Washington’s restored edge rush challenges Philadelphia’s new offensive rhythm
2026_01_WAS_PHI.paragraph1: Washington enters Philadelphia with its entire 53-man roster cleared, including edge rushers Odafe Oweh and K'Lavon Chaisson, while the Eagles will be without Jonathan Greenard and rookie tight end Eli Stowers. That gives the Commanders more flexibility to pressure Jalen Hurts and test Philadelphia’s protection without overcommitting coverage help. The Eagles can answer by leaning on their run game and forcing Washington to tackle consistently. Edge pressure, early-down rushing efficiency and the ability to prevent Hurts from extending plays should define this divisional opener.
2026_01_WAS_PHI.model_rationale: Washington’s healthier edge rotation gives it a credible disruption path, but Philadelphia can blunt that advantage by staying balanced, protecting Hurts and forcing the Commanders to defend long drives.
